scope: 226 strict ordinary window/fixture controls; two independently retained catalog observations, not hidden passes

case.label: create-source
case.sql: CREATE TABLE wh_source(id INTEGER,p INTEGER,v BIGINT,n INTEGER,t TEXT)

case.label: physical-families
case.sql: SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS rn,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS rk,dense_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS dr,ntile(2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS nt,lag(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS lg,lead(v,1,-99::bigint) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS ld FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: derived-values-families
case.sql: SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS rn,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS rk,dense_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS dr,ntile(2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS nt,lag(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS lg,lead(v,1,-99::bigint) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS ld FROM (VALUES(1,0,9007199254740993::bigint,0,''::text),(2,0,9007199254740994::bigint,1,'NULL'),(3,0,NULL::bigint,-1,NULL::text),(4,1,-9007199254740993::bigint,NULL::integer,'β'),(5,1,-9007199254740994::bigint,1,' spaced '),(6,1,-9007199254740994::bigint,2,'z')) AS s(id,p,v,n,t) ORDER BY id

case.label: derived-physical-families
case.sql: SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS rn,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS rk,dense_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST) AS dr,ntile(2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS nt,lag(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS lg,lead(v,1,-99::bigint) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS ld FROM (SELECT id,p,v,n,t FROM wh_source) AS s ORDER BY id

case.label: cte-families
case.sql: WITH q AS(SELECT id,p,v,n,t FROM wh_source) SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id),lag(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id),sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p) FROM q ORDER BY id

case.label: join-families
case.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY a.p ORDER BY a.id,b.id),lag(a.v) OVER(PARTITION BY a.p ORDER BY a.id,b.id) FROM wh_source a JOIN wh_other b ON a.p=b.p ORDER BY a.id,b.id

case.label: left-join-null-source
case.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id,lag(b.id,0) OVER(ORDER BY a.id),count(b.id) OVER() FROM wh_source a LEFT JOIN wh_other b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id

case.label: ranking-all
case.sql: SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id),rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),dense_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),percent_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),cume_dist() OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),ntile(2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: named-default-frame
case.sql: SELECT id,first_value(v) OVER w,last_value(v) OVER w,nth_value(v,2) OVER w FROM wh_source WINDOW w AS(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

case.label: named-derived-frame
case.sql: SELECT id,first_value(v) OVER w,last_value(v) OVER(w ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source WINDOW w AS(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

case.label: default-peer-last-value
case.sql: SELECT id,last_value(p) OVER(ORDER BY p),first_value(id) OVER(ORDER BY p,id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING),count(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING),min(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING),max(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),count(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),min(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),max(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),count(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),min(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),max(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),count(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),min(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),max(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),count(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),min(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),max(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: frame-exclude-CURRENT ROW
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(id) OVER(ORDER BY p RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW),first_value(id) OVER(ORDER BY p,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: frame-exclude-GROUP
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(id) OVER(ORDER BY p RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP),first_value(id) OVER(ORDER BY p,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE GROUP) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: frame-exclude-TIES
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(id) OVER(ORDER BY p RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES),first_value(id) OVER(ORDER BY p,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE TIES) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: frame-exclude-NO OTHERS
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(id) OVER(ORDER BY p RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS),first_value(id) OVER(ORDER BY p,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-all-types
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p),avg(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p),count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY p),bool_and(n>0) OVER(PARTITION BY p),bit_or(id) OVER(PARTITION BY p),string_agg(t,'|') OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING),array_agg(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: scalar-child
case.sql: SELECT (SELECT row_number() OVER()) AS r,(SELECT lag(v,0) OVER() FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AS v

case.label: scalar-child LIMIT 0
case.sql: SELECT (SELECT row_number() OVER()) AS r,(SELECT lag(v,0) OVER() FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AS v LIMIT 0

case.label: scalar-child WHERE false
case.sql: SELECT (SELECT row_number() OVER()) AS r,(SELECT lag(v,0) OVER() FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) AS v WHERE false

case.label: correlated-direct-child
case.sql: SELECT a.id,(SELECT lag(a.v,0) OVER()) AS v FROM wh_source a ORDER BY a.id

case.label: correlated-physical-child
case.sql: SELECT a.id,(SELECT last_value(b.v) OVER(ORDER BY b.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source b WHERE b.p=a.p ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1) AS v FROM wh_source a ORDER BY a.id

case.label: grandparent-window-child
case.sql: SELECT a.id,(SELECT (SELECT first_value(a.v) OVER())) FROM wh_source a ORDER BY a.id

case.label: scalar-cardinality
case.sql: SELECT (SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source)

case.label: count-child-row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id)
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) ORDER BY column1 LIMIT (SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

case.label: count-child-lag(n) OVER(ORDER BY id)
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) ORDER BY column1 LIMIT (SELECT lag(n) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

case.label: count-child-lead(n) OVER(ORDER BY id)
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) ORDER BY column1 LIMIT (SELECT lead(n) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

case.label: count-window-cardinality
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) LIMIT (SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source)

case.label: projection-hidden-order
case.sql: SELECT id,coalesce(lag(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id),-77::bigint)+1 AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY sum(v) OVER(PARTITION BY p),id LIMIT 4 OFFSET 1

case.label: outer-expression-window
case.sql: SELECT id,(row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id)+id)::bigint AS r,CASE WHEN lag(v) OVER(ORDER BY id) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS z FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: case-pruned-window-argument
case.sql: SELECT id,CASE WHEN false THEN lag(1/(id-3)) OVER(ORDER BY id) ELSE 7 END FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: runtime-discarded-window-key-error
case.sql: SELECT id FROM wh_source ORDER BY lag(1/(id-3),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) LIMIT 1

case.label: window-where-error
case.sql: SELECT id FROM wh_source WHERE row_number() OVER()>0

case.label: window-count-current-level-error
case.sql: SELECT id FROM wh_source LIMIT row_number() OVER()

case.label: nested-window-error
case.sql: SELECT lag(row_number() OVER()) OVER() FROM wh_source

case.label: window-distinct-error
case.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT p) OVER() FROM wh_source

case.label: window-type-error-under-zero
case.sql: SELECT lag(v,TRUE) OVER() FROM wh_source LIMIT 0

case.label: window-missing-column-under-zero
case.sql: SELECT lag(missing) OVER() FROM wh_source LIMIT 0

case.label: nth-zero-execution-error
case.sql: SELECT nth_value(v,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source

case.label: ntile-zero-execution-error
case.sql: SELECT ntile(0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source

case.label: zero-prunes-runtime-error
case.sql: SELECT nth_value(v,0) OVER(ORDER BY id),ntile(0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source LIMIT 0

case.label: filter-error-pruning
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(1/(id-3)) FILTER(WHERE id<>3) OVER(),sum(1/(id-3)) FILTER(WHERE NULL) OVER() FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: create-float
case.sql: CREATE TABLE wh_float(id INTEGER,v DOUBLE PRECISION)

case.label: float-nan-peer-identity
case.sql: SELECT id,rank() OVER(ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),dense_rank() OVER(ORDER BY v NULLS LAST),lag(v,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_float ORDER BY id

case.label: oid-record-array-values
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(o,0) OVER(ORDER BY id),lag(a,0) OVER(ORDER BY id),first_value(r) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND CURRENT ROW) FROM(VALUES(1,'integer'::regtype,ARRAY['integer'::regtype,NULL::regtype,'text'::regtype],ROW(1,ROW(),NULL::integer)),(2,NULL::regtype,ARRAY[]::regtype[],ROW(2,ROW(),3)),(3,'bigint'::regtype,NULL::regtype[],NULL::record)) AS s(id,o,a,r) ORDER BY id

case.label: enum-rank-and-value
case.sql: SELECT id,rank() OVER(ORDER BY e NULLS LAST),lag(e,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_enum_source ORDER BY id

case.label: ntile-retry-null-first
case.sql: SELECT id,ntile(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN NULL ELSE nextval('wh_tile')::integer END) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source WHERE p=0 ORDER BY id

case.label: lag-null-offset-prunes-value-default
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('wh_value'),NULL::integer,nextval('wh_default')) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: lag-target-null-does-not-default
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,0,nextval('wh_default')) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: lag-default-current-row-only-on-miss
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,99,nextval('wh_default')) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: lag-offset-and-target-value-per-demand
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('wh_value'),nextval('wh_offset')::integer-2,nextval('wh_default')) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: nth-null-prunes-value
case.sql: SELECT id,nth_value(nextval('wh_value'),NULL::integer) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: nth-value-re-evaluates-target
case.sql: SELECT id,nth_value(nextval('wh_value'),1) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: aggregate-full-frame-filter-once
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(nextval('wh_arg')) FILTER(WHERE nextval('wh_filter')%2=0) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: frame-zero-prunes-offsets
case.sql: SELECT sum(v) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN (nextval('wh_start')-1) PRECEDING AND (nextval('wh_end')-1) FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source LIMIT 0

case.label: frame-empty-input-still-evaluates-offsets
case.sql: SELECT sum(v) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN (nextval('wh_start')-1) PRECEDING AND (nextval('wh_end')-1) FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source WHERE false

case.label: text-offset-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,$1,$2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: text-offset-null-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,$1,$2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: text-ntile-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,ntile($1) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: text-ntile-runtime-error
case.sql: SELECT id,ntile($1) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: text-count-window-child-parameter
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) ORDER BY column1 LIMIT(SELECT ntile($1) OVER())

case.label: binary-offset-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,$1,$2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: binary-offset-null-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,$1,$2) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: binary-ntile-parameter
case.sql: SELECT id,ntile($1) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: binary-ntile-runtime-error
case.sql: SELECT id,ntile($1) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: binary-count-window-child-parameter
case.sql: VALUES(3),(1),(2) ORDER BY column1 LIMIT(SELECT ntile($1) OVER())

case.label: limit1-no-order-row_number
case.sql: SELECT x,row_number() OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_row_number')),(nextval('wh_flow_row_number')),(nextval('wh_flow_row_number')),(nextval('wh_flow_row_number')),(nextval('wh_flow_row_number')),(nextval('wh_flow_row_number'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-rank
case.sql: SELECT x,rank() OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_rank'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-dense_rank
case.sql: SELECT x,dense_rank() OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_dense_rank'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-lag
case.sql: SELECT x,lag(x) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_lag')),(nextval('wh_flow_lag')),(nextval('wh_flow_lag')),(nextval('wh_flow_lag')),(nextval('wh_flow_lag')),(nextval('wh_flow_lag'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-lead
case.sql: SELECT x,lead(x) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_lead')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-lead2
case.sql: SELECT x,lead(x,2) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_lead2')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead2')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead2')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead2')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead2')),(nextval('wh_flow_lead2'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-first
case.sql: SELECT x,first_value(x) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_first')),(nextval('wh_flow_first')),(nextval('wh_flow_first')),(nextval('wh_flow_first')),(nextval('wh_flow_first')),(nextval('wh_flow_first'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-last
case.sql: SELECT x,last_value(x) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_last')),(nextval('wh_flow_last')),(nextval('wh_flow_last')),(nextval('wh_flow_last')),(nextval('wh_flow_last')),(nextval('wh_flow_last'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-nth2
case.sql: SELECT x,nth_value(x,2) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_nth2')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth2')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth2')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth2')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth2')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth2'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-nth_null
case.sql: SELECT x,nth_value(x,NULL::integer) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_nth_null'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-ntile
case.sql: SELECT x,ntile(2) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_ntile')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-ntile_null
case.sql: SELECT x,ntile(NULL::integer) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null')),(nextval('wh_flow_ntile_null'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-percent_rank
case.sql: SELECT x,percent_rank() OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank')),(nextval('wh_flow_percent_rank'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-cume_dist
case.sql: SELECT x,cume_dist() OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist')),(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist')),(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist')),(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist')),(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist')),(nextval('wh_flow_cume_dist'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-sum_full
case.sql: SELECT x,sum(x) OVER() AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_full'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-sum_prefix
case.sql: SELECT x,sum(x) OVER(ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_prefix'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: limit1-no-order-sum_follow1
case.sql: SELECT x,sum(x) OVER(ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS w FROM (VALUES(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1')),(nextval('wh_flow_sum_follow1'))) AS s(x) LIMIT 1

case.label: two-specs-stage-order
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('wh_stage'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('wh_stage'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id DESC) AS b FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: two-specs-reversed-targets
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('wh_stage'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id DESC) AS b,lag(nextval('wh_stage'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: hidden-window-projection-demand
case.sql: SELECT id,nextval('wh_projection') AS x FROM wh_source ORDER BY row_number() OVER(ORDER BY id DESC) LIMIT 1

case.label: scalar-default-child-actual-context
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,(SELECT 1),(SELECT nextval('wh_scalar_count'))) OVER(PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: named-second-window-inherits
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v) OVER w2,last_value(v) OVER w2 FROM wh_source WINDOW w1 AS(PARTITION BY p),w2 AS(w1 ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY id

case.label: named-frame-direct-allowed
case.sql: SELECT id,last_value(v) OVER w FROM wh_source WINDOW w AS(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY id

case.label: named-frame-copy-forbidden
case.sql: SELECT id,last_value(v) OVER(w) FROM wh_source WINDOW w AS(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY id

case.label: named-partition-override-forbidden
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v) OVER w2 FROM wh_source WINDOW w1 AS(PARTITION BY p),w2 AS(w1 PARTITION BY p ORDER BY id)

case.label: create-shadow-row-number
case.sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.row_number() RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE SQL AS $$SELECT 99::bigint$$

case.label: create-shadow-lag
case.sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.lag(bigint) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE SQL AS $$SELECT 77::bigint$$

case.label: qualified-lag-shadow-over-error
case.sql: SELECT public.lag(v) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM wh_source LIMIT 0

case.label: exact-range-bigint-RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(ORDER BY v RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING),count(v) OVER(ORDER BY v RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: exact-range-bigint-GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(v) OVER(ORDER BY v GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING),count(v) OVER(ORDER BY v GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: oid-key-original-comparator
case.sql: SELECT id,rank() OVER(ORDER BY o),lag(o,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM(VALUES(1,'boolean'::regtype),(2,'bigint'::regtype),(3,'integer'::regtype)) AS s(id,o) ORDER BY id

case.label: record-key-original-comparator
case.sql: SELECT id,rank() OVER(ORDER BY r),lag(r,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) FROM(VALUES(1,ROW(9007199254740993::bigint,'b'::text)),(2,ROW(9007199254740994::bigint,'a'::text)),(3,ROW(NULL::bigint,'z'::text))) AS s(id,r) ORDER BY id

case.label: same-spec-distinct-volatile-sites
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('wh_duplicate'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('wh_duplicate'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: same-spec-pure-duplicates
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(v,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(v,0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: volatile-aggregate-prefix
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(nextval('wh_prefix')) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: volatile-aggregate-moving
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(nextval('wh_moving')) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: volatile-aggregate-exclusion
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(nextval('wh_exclusion')) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING EXCLUDE CURRENT ROW) FROM wh_source ORDER BY id

case.label: catalog-table-identities
case.sql: SELECT oid,relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN('wh_source','wh_other','wh_float','wh_enum_source')

case.label: catalog-type-identities
case.sql: SELECT oid,typname FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN('wh_enum','_wh_enum')
